summary.text: Wes Peterson is the Working Class Party candidate for Michigan State Senate District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the party's June 6, 2026 convention.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a software engineer in East Lansing.

paragraphs.text: In his Ballotpedia survey, Peterson said he is running to offer solutions to problems facing workers that the two-party system leaves unaddressed.
He said he supports public utilities, housing cooperatives and publicly built housing, protecting the right to organize, and helping workers buy their workplaces when they come up for sale.
He also said he supports ranked choice voting and proportional representation, and named technology policy as a personal interest because he writes software for a living.
